deviceCode.description: High-entropy bearer capability the device polls with. Never log or display it.

userCode.description: Short display code the user types on the dashboard verification page.

verificationUrl.description: Dashboard verification page URL where the user approves this device.

interval.description: Minimum number of seconds the device must wait between polls.

expiresAt.description: Instant after which the device and user codes are no longer redeemable.

actionType.description: Stable identifier for the out-of-band step a flow is blocked on. New blocking steps are added HERE so resume stays one generalized contract.

instruction.description: Human-facing instruction describing the step a person must complete out of band.

url.description: Where to send the human to complete the step, when a destination exists.

continuationToken.description: Short-lived, single-use-on-completion, principal-scoped capability the agent presents to POST /v1/actions/resume to poll and complete this exact flow. Treat as a secret; never log it.

pollAfterSeconds.description: Minimum number of seconds to wait before calling resume again (retry-after hint).

expiresAt.description: Instant by which the human step must be completed — the originating flow's own deadline. Resume after this returns a terminal `expired` status (the token survives a short grace past this so resume can report that), but the flow can no longer be redeemed.

status.description: Device authorization state. `approved` carries the one-time API key exactly once, then the record is `consumed`.

apiKey.description: The minted API key including its one-time `secret`. Present only on the first poll after approval.

name.description: Human-readable key name.

type.description: Subject kind the key acts as in audit records.
Principal type that owns this key.

id.description: Stable principal id (Better Auth team id or external id).

ownerPrincipal.description: Owning principal (ownership metadata, never the authorization gate).

anyOf.description: Named policy preset compiled into a concrete access policy at key creation.

preset.description: Preset the policy was compiled from, if any.

teamScope.description: Membership-following team scope for a device-login key, or null for legacy keys.

version.description: Policy schema version. Must be the current platform policy version.

effect.description: Statement effect. Explicit deny always wins over allow.

items.description: A namespaced IAM-lite action (`noun:verb`) or `*` for all actions.

A resource URI from the StatticResource union: stt://tenant/{t}, …/principal/(team|external)/{id}[/*], …/site/{id}[/*], …/space/{id}[/*], …/site/{id}/space/{id}[/*], …/domain/{id}, or …/domain-group/{id}.

resources.description: Resource URIs this statement covers (wildcards cover subtrees).

conditions.description: ANDed condition attributes. Unresolvable attributes fail closed: no-match for allow, match for deny.

request.client.description: Restricts the statement to one resolved request client.

statements.description: Evaluation: explicit deny wins, explicit allow permits, otherwise implicit deny.

anyOf.description: IAM-lite access policy evaluated for every credentialed request.

policy.description: Effective access policy. A key authorizes by policy only.

secretPreview.description: Masked secret preview (prefix and last characters).

secret.description: Full secret. Returned once, at creation only.

notBefore.description: Key is rejected before this instant.

expiresAt.description: Key is rejected from this instant.

ipAllowlist.description: CIDR/IP allowlist. Requests from other addresses are rejected.

updatedAt.description: Last update instant.

claimedSpaceId.description: Space claimed during approval, when the device flow was started by `sf spaces claim`.

default.description: Error envelope. Any 4xx/5xx response is the shared `{ error }` shape.

parameters.description: Optional client-generated key (max 255 characters) that makes this write safe to retry. parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional client-generated key (max 255 characters) that makes this write safe to retry. The first request with a given key stores its outcome scoped to your tenant, credential, and route; a retry with the same key and an identical body replays that stored response (marked `Idempotency-Replayed: true`) instead of executing again. Reusing a key with a different body returns 409 `idempotency_key_reused`; a still-in-flight duplicate returns 409 `idempotency_conflict_in_progress`. Keys are retained for 24 hours.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional client-generated key (max 255 characters) that makes this write safe to retry. The first request with a given key stores its outcome scoped to your tenant, credential, and route; a retry with the same key and an identical body replays that stored response (marked `Idempotency-Replayed: true`) instead of executing again. Reusing a key with a different body returns 409 `idempotency_key_reused`; a still-in-flight duplicate returns 409 `idempotency_conflict_in_progress`. Keys are retained for 24 hours.
